sources: recreation.gov search API campsite catalog for 233710 (11 sites)
Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: 11 sites in one loop, gravel aprons; 7 are catalogued tent-only. The FS caps trailers at 25 ft; only two sites take 23 ft or more: 001 (30 ft, pull-through) and 009 (26 ft, back-in). 004 takes 22 ft; the rest 14-22 ft.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog 233710 (sites 001-007, 009-012; 001 Max Vehicle Length 30 Pull-through, 009 26 Back-in, 004 22, others 14-22; permitted equipment RV/Motorhome only at 001, 004, 009) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/aspen-campground ('Parking aprons are gravel and can fit up to two vehicles with a maximum trailer length of 25 feet.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump; picnic table, fire ring or grate and pedestal grill at each site; firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/aspen-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'A picnic table, fire ring or grate and a pedestal grill are at each site.') + recreation.gov 233710 ('drinking water from a hand pump'; 'Firewood is available for sale at host site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Open mid-May to mid-October, weather permitting; the recreation-area gate is open 24 hours in season. Roads are not plowed in winter.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/aspen-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October.'; 'Jefferson Lake Recreation area typically operates between mid May and mid October weather permitting. During operating season, the gate to the recreation area is open 24 hours.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov season 2026: May 15 - Oct 11 (2027: May 14 - Oct 10). Booking closes 5 days before arrival; sites not reserved by then become first-come walk-ups, which must be occupied the same night (pay at the self-service fee tube: cash, check or money order). 14 consecutive nights maximum; 2-night weekend minimum on reservations. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; up to eight people, two tents and two vehicles or one RV per site.

booking.source: recreation.gov 233710 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2 (soft), reservationCutOff 5; notice: 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up and are available on a first come - first serve bases.'; rates: Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11, 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10) + FS page ('First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $24 a site per night, two vehicles or one RV included; $11 for a third vehicle. Plus a one-time $11 Jefferson Lake Recreation Area entry fee per stay ($100 annual pass).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/aspen-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night'; '$11 fee for a third vehicle.') + recreation.gov 233710 notice ('There is a one-time fee of $11.00 to enter Jefferson Lake Recreation Area ... only once for the duration of your stay. ... Annual Pass ... $100.00') + rates (2026 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $24), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior and Access pass holders get 50% off the site they occupy (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/aspen-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS (Pike-San Isabel NF, South Park Ranger District), concessionaire-run, in the Jefferson Lake Recreation Area at 9,900 ft: a single loop under aspen and spruce near Jefferson Creek, a few miles below Jefferson Lake. From Jefferson on US-285, County Road 35 about 2 miles then County Road 37 about 2.5 miles (gravel). Colorado Trail access nearby. --Claude
